products.name: Decktopus
products.note: AI presentation maker; automated design; content generation; data exposure

profile_text.body:
Decktopus is a Turkish software company that offers an AI-powered presentation tool of the same name. The company describes its product as an AI presentation maker that generates a complete deck, including structure, content, and design, from a topic description or uploaded file. Users can also provide a website URL to have the tool pull in brand colors, fonts, and a logo automatically.

The Decktopus product is categorized as a slides and presentations tool and includes features such as automated design, content generation, Zapier integration for workflow automation, and availability as an app inside ChatGPT. The platform does not offer a free plan but provides free credits at signup for a three-slide presentation. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256 on AWS infrastructure, and the company states it does not use customer data for AI training; SOC 2 Type II compliance is described as currently in progress.

The site's held facts note a data exposure flag against the product listing. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
